extractionRules: Current open order follows layouts[":threads"] leaf order, then remaining open panes.
The density study includes up to fourteen active-workspace chats; requested historic titles are prioritized and archived chats retain closed=true and open=false.
Each record contains only thread ID, title, workspace label, closed/open flags, participant IDs and display names, plus up to the last three nonempty human or assistant transcript excerpts.
Transcript excerpts are trimmed to 600 characters; excerpts matching credential, token, private-key, path, or tool-data patterns are omitted.
Backend configuration, personas, credentials, tool records, attachments, permissions, environment, filesystem paths, and composer drafts are excluded.
notes: The source snapshot contained four open chats in the active workspace at capture time.
